pictures.scene: Francisco de Zurbaran, Fray Pedro Machado - the friar in his white habit writing with a quill over the great open book on the red draped table, give praise O servants of the LORD who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God
pictures.name: pd_zurbaran_dienaars

pictures.scene: El Greco, Annunciation - Mary kneeling at her book with her hand raised while the dove comes down on a shaft of gold light and the angel holds out the lily, Hallelujah for the LORD is good, for the LORD has chosen Jacob as His own, Israel as His treasured possession
pictures.name: pd_greco_eigendom

pictures.scene: Francesco Zuccarelli, Landscape - the great leaning tree over a wide pale sky with the valley and the town lying far below and the herder driving his white cow down to the water, for I know that the LORD is great, our Lord is above all gods, the LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth
pictures.name: pd_zuccarelli_groot

pictures.scene: Andreas Achenbach, Storm at Sea off the Norwegian Coast - the towering storm cloud over a ship heeling under the breaking seas beside the rock cliffs, He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth, He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses
pictures.name: pd_achenbach_wind

pictures.scene: Albrecht Durer, Lot and His Daughters - the family walking away down the road while the cities of the plain burn behind them under a towering column of black smoke, He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, He sent signs and wonders into your midst O Egypt against Pharaoh and all his servants
pictures.name: pd_durer_wonderen

pictures.scene: Otto van Veen, Valentinus wordt krijgsgevangen gemaakt - the horsemen locked together in the melee with a rider's sword raised and a white horse rearing over the fallen, He struck down many nations and slaughtered mighty kings, Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan and all the kings of Canaan
pictures.name: pd_veen_koningen

pictures.scene: Adriaen van de Velde, Portret van een echtpaar met twee kinderen en een min in een landschap - the family standing on their own land with the carriage on the track behind them and their cattle and sheep grazing up to the trees, He gave their land as an inheritance as a heritage to His people Israel, Your name O LORD endures forever through all generations
pictures.name: pd_velde_erfdeel

pictures.scene: Abraham Bloemaert, Joseph and his Brothers - Joseph crowned on his throne under the green canopy reaching out his open hand to the hand his brother lifts up to him, for the LORD will vindicate His people and will have compassion on His servants
pictures.name: pd_bloemaert_ontferming

pictures.scene: Willem Kalf, Stilleven met zilveren schenkkan - the worked silver ewer and the gilt standing cup and the porcelain bowl of lemons set out together in a dark stone niche, the idols of the nations are silver and gold made by the hands of men, they have mouths but cannot speak, eyes but cannot see, ears but cannot hear
pictures.name: pd_kalf_zilver

pictures.scene: Bartholomeus Breenbergh, Preaching of John the Baptist - the preacher standing up on the rock with his hand lifted over the whole crowd gathered in the valley to hear him, those who make them become like them as do all who trust in them, O house of Israel bless the LORD, O house of Aaron bless the LORD, O house of Levi bless the LORD
pictures.name: pd_breenbergh_zegent

pictures.scene: Andrea di Bartolo, The Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple - the high priest in red and white standing in the temple door with his hand held out to the child who has climbed the steps to him with her book, you who fear the LORD bless the LORD, blessed be the LORD from Zion, He who dwells in Jerusalem, Hallelujah
pictures.name: pd_bartolo_sion

lines.text: Hallelujah!
Praise the name of the LORD.
Give praise, O servants of the LORD,
who stand in the house of the LORD,
in the courts of the house of our God.
Hallelujah, for the LORD is good;
sing praises to His name, for it is lovely.
For the LORD has chosen Jacob as His own,
Israel as His treasured possession.
For I know that the LORD is great;
our Lord is above all gods.
The LORD does all that pleases Him
in the heavens and on the earth,
in the seas and in all their depths.
He causes the clouds to rise
from the ends of the earth.
He generates the lightning with the rain
and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
He struck down the firstborn of Egypt,
of both man and beast.
He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt,
against Pharaoh and all his servants.
He struck down many nations
and slaughtered mighty kings:
Sihon king of the Amorites,
Og king of Bashan,
and all the kings of Canaan.
He gave their land as an inheritance,
as a heritage to His people Israel.
Your name, O LORD, endures forever,
Your renown, O LORD, through all generations.
For the LORD will vindicate His people
and will have compassion on His servants.
The idols of the nations are silver and gold,
made by the hands of men.
They have mouths, but cannot speak;
they have eyes, but cannot see;
they have ears, but cannot hear;
nor is there breath in their mouths.
Those who make them become like them,
as do all who trust in them.
O house of Israel, bless the LORD;
O house of Aaron, bless the LORD;
O house of Levi, bless the LORD;
you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!
Blessed be the LORD from Zion—
He who dwells in Jerusalem.
Hallelujah!
